accepted.verify: Accepted. The BPTT bullet in rnn-sequence stops mid-explanation to hand the mechanism to another card: "the same product-of-derivatives that causes vanishing/exploding gradients in deep nets (see neural-net-fundamentals) causes it here too". It never explains backprop or vanishing gradients itself. Yet three of its five capabilities depend on them. BPTT is backprop. LSTM gating is described as "the actual fix for vanishing gradients". Refuted. First, the concept gap is not filled by the prereq. model-evaluation never defines TPR or FPR. It only uses classification_report, a confusion-matrix plot and ROC-AUC, and assumes the reader already knows those terms, so adding the edge would not give the learner the missing definitions. Second, ai-ethics-fairness is a conceptual reference skill (type: reference, no code). It glosses each metric in plain language: equalized odds is 'Is the model equally accurate for each group, conditioned on the true label?', equal opportunity is about 'false negatives (denying a qualified candidate)', and predictive parity is 'when the model says yes, is it equally trustworthy for every group?'. Third, most of the skill is fully self-contained: demographic parity and the disparate impact ratio (both selection rates), where bias comes from, the impossibility result, and mitigation strategies. So model-evaluation is useful background, not a block, and the existing related link already captures the relationship.

A learner can run the whole forecasting and backtesting workflow without it, which makes this useful background rather than a blocker.

This is the 'useful background' case the criteria exclude. reinforcement-learning is a conceptual reference card. Expectation ('expected discounted return'), conditional probability P(s'|s,a), variance and gradient ascent show up as general mathematical vocabulary, not as techniques ml-math-essentials specifically teaches and the card relies on. The main content (MDP tuple, Markov property, Bellman recursion, epsilon-greedy, the TD update, on- vs off-policy, the deadly triad) can be followed with general math literacy, as the proposer admits. By the same reasoning ml-math-essentials would become a prerequisite of nearly every skill, which defeats the goal of a few high-confidence edges. Given the uncertainty, reject.
